description: Convert between .nowline source text and its JSON AST representation. `to:json` serializes a .nowline file to the JSON AST; `to:nowline` pretty-prints a JSON AST back to canonical .nowline source.

path.description: Real local filesystem path to the source file. Never pass a virtual or sandbox path such as /mnt/user-data/… — pass `source` instead.

to.description: "json" — serialize .nowline text to JSON AST. "nowline" — pretty-print a JSON AST back to .nowline source.

name: convert
